spec.title: OpenRouter
spec.description: Generations from OpenRouter Broadcast: billed spend by model, API key, upstream provider and user, plus tokens, latency and outcomes.

list.name: model_re
list.label: Model (regex)
list.description: Filter by model, for example anthropic/.* or .*gpt.*

list.name: key_re
list.label: API key (regex)
list.description: Filter by OpenRouter API key name

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Generations through OpenRouter. Grafana Cloud runs a TraceQL metrics query over 25 hours at most, so keep the time range at 24 hours or less.

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: What OpenRouter billed for these generations (gen_ai.usage.total_cost).

panels.title: Avg cost / request
panels.description: Spend divided by requests. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Cached input share
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens the upstream provider served from its cache. Empty when no provider reported cached tokens. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of generations finished faster than this (bucketed to powers of two). Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Spend by model
panels.description: Billed cost in each time bucket by model. The legend total is the spend over the range.

panels.title: Spend by API key
panels.description: Which OpenRouter API key spent the money. Give each app or machine its own key to tell them apart.

panels.title: Spend by upstream provider
panels.description: The provider OpenRouter routed each request to.

panels.title: Spend by user
panels.description: By the request's user field, or your OpenRouter account when it is not set.

panels.title: Spend by session
panels.description: By session_id (or the x-session-id header). (not set) when the client sends none.

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Prompt plus completion tokens in each time bucket by model. The legend total is the sum over the range.

panels.title: p95 by upstream provider
panels.description: Slow providers show up here. OpenRouter's provider routing preferences can avoid them. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Finish reasons
panels.description: stop: finished. tool_calls: asked for a tool. length: cut off by max_tokens. content_filter: blocked. error: failed upstream.

panels.title: Latest generations
panels.description: The most recent generations. Click a trace ID to open it.
